BiblicalUsage: Meshullemeth is the mother of King Amon, named once in the record of his reign. 2 Kings 21:19 says Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a mother's name in a bad king's record is no blame on her: the record keeps her because she was his mother, and his sins were his own.
